ranked.headline: Computational methods reconstruct and align spatial transcriptomic tissue measurements
ranked.summary: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics data now demand methods that reconstruct, align, and interpret tissue expression across scales and modalities.

ranked.headline: Variational autoencoders and diffusion models are applied to neural and omics data
ranked.summary: Generative and representation models are being adapted to noisy neural, single-cell, and clinical data with missing modalities and site shifts.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer cell-context splicing and cross-species single-cell alignment
ranked.summary: Learned models are moving from single-gene annotation toward representations of regulatory context across cell types and species.

ranked.headline: Computational methods advance structure-based drug design and virtual screening
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published platform target affinity prediction, synthesizability, and ensemble refinement in structure-based design.

ranked.headline: Learned biological models tested for shortcuts, interpretability and generalization
ranked.summary: Evaluation design and attribution testing now scrutinize what learned models of omics and single-cell data actually capture, not only their predictive accuracy.

ranked.headline: Learned representations guide peptide design and protein binding prediction
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers now directly test how input representation, charge, and generative peptide design affect binding predictions.

ranked.headline: Reducing representational cost of genomic sequences for DNA and genome models
ranked.summary: Pangenome alignments and long-context DNA models motivate compression methods that cut representational cost without enlarging models.

ranked.headline: Learned models encode evolutionary constraints in proteins, codons and antibodies
ranked.summary: Learned models now address evolutionary trajectories, peptide sequencing, binder design and codon usage, with new training objectives.

ranked.headline: Plasma chromatin, single-cell atlases and language models infer cancer genomic states
ranked.summary: Noninvasive plasma chromatin profiling and pan-cancer single-cell maps now enable inference of tumor expression and therapeutic heterogeneity.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for within-host and lineage-level pathogen sequence interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair simulation and alignment-free modeling with pathogen sequence and molecular-feature interpretation.

ranked.headline: Learned models score drug, protein and binding interactions from heterogeneous inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply graph and attention models to public bioactivity, knowledge-graph and sequence data for interaction scoring.

ranked.headline: Somatic structural variants and two-hit losses define genomic instability across tumors
ranked.summary: Donor-specific assemblies and TCGA-scale allele-specific analyses now resolve structural variation and tumor suppressor two-hit events more precisely.

ranked.headline: Faster alignment and phylogenetic placement tools for large-scale sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Sequence comparison is shifting toward parallel and heuristic formulations, with new tools reporting speedups over existing aligners.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide STRs and haplotype similarity refine human population structure inference
ranked.summary: Genome-wide STRs, SNPs and haplotype-resolved assemblies are now refining ancestry estimation and population structure inference.

ranked.headline: Computational annotation of HERV LTRs and RNA regulatory interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications introduce scalable tools for LTR annotation, RBP-RNA interaction mapping, and tRNA modification detection.

ranked.headline: Agents convert biomedical sources into audit-gated, provenance-traced knowledge claims
ranked.summary: Multi-agent and audit-gated LLM pipelines now produce provenance-traced biomedical graphs and target-disease evidence from literature and enrichment outputs.

ranked.headline: Per-event quantification of single molecules with explicit measurement reliability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply Bayesian, tracking, FRET, and nanopore ML pipelines to individual molecular events.

ranked.headline: Stochastic reaction dynamics quantify fluctuations in gene expression models
ranked.summary: Three February 2026 preprints model gene expression as stochastic chemical reaction networks, moving beyond mean-level kinetic descriptions.

ranked.headline: Zero-shot predictors break down on epistatic mutation combinations
ranked.summary: Benchmarks show zero-shot variant predictors fail under strong epistasis, while new evolutionary generative models target controllable sequence design.

ranked.headline: Causal and lineage-informed inference of gene regulatory networks from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Million-cell single-cell datasets and pooled perturbation and lineage barcode designs are making structure-aware computational inference practical.

ranked.headline: Learned models map biomedical measurements to aging, brain, and disease phenotypes
ranked.summary: Population-scale cohorts and imaging now pair with uncertainty-aware and interpretable neural models to nominate candidate loci, metabolites, and subtypes.

ranked.headline: Inferring pathogen variant composition from wastewater and mixed sequencing data
ranked.summary: Mixed and indirect datasets are now modeled computationally to infer pathogen genotype and abundance without isolate-level sequencing.

ranked.headline: Experimental and reference data constrain structural models of protein conformations
ranked.summary: Large MD conformational datasets and QM/MM reference data are now being used to parameterize and validate structural models.

ranked.headline: Chromatin profiling and 3D genome methods map noncoding regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair single-cell trimodal profiling with deep learning and condensate-linked 3D enhancer modeling to resolve noncoding regulatory activity.

ranked.headline: Sequencing-derived inference of host, plasmid, and gene-level properties in microbiomes
ranked.summary: Nanopore, read-level, and likelihood-based methods now resolve plasmid hosts, host sex, and genomic-island pathogenicity from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Computational recovery of identifications from existing mass spectrometry datasets
ranked.summary: Prior identifications, acquisition geometry, and repository-scale spectra now guide faster, broader proteomics searches.

ranked.headline: Standalone software packages make regulatory, genomic, and phenotype analyses reusable
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 releases offer accessible, reusable tools spanning regulatory, genotyping, phenotype, and cancer transcriptomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Gene model accuracy as a prerequisite for cross-lineage genomic comparison
ranked.summary: Manual curation and multi-species annotation show that cross-lineage comparisons hinge on accurate gene models and orthology.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic and metabolic modeling prioritize liver disease mechanisms and targets
ranked.summary: Tissue- and cell-resolved models and gene-level causal multi-omics now enable mechanistic target prioritization from existing transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Spatial structure in epidemic spread and immune cell co-occurrence near plaques
ranked.summary: Spatially explicit models now quantify near-neighbour spread in citrus disease and environment-dependent co-occurrence in amyloid-plaque immune cells.

ranked.headline: Protonation and ion handling shape membrane transport and penetration in MD simulations
ranked.summary: Long-timescale and all-atom simulations now resolve protonation-dependent and environment-dependent membrane states at atomic resolution.

ranked.headline: Pangenomes link structural variants to fruit color and stress resistance in crops
ranked.summary: Multi-accession pangenomes and variant-effect pipelines now connect reference-quality genomes with agronomic trait associations in crop breeding.

ranked.headline: Semi-tryptic peptides and degradation graphs map proteolytic activity in proteomes
ranked.summary: Unlabelled and single-snapshot proteomic data are now being mined to infer proteolytic cleavage activity and neo-epitope landscapes.

ranked.headline: Genomic lineages, protein folds and defense systems track microbial diversification
ranked.summary: Population, structural and defense-system genomics now allow direct comparison of lineage history and repertoire size in shaping microbial diversity.

ranked.headline: Scalable computational tools for protein homology and proteome reconstruction
ranked.summary: Remote homology detection and proteome reconstruction across eukaryotes now rely on integrated scoring and parallelized search at database scale.

ranked.headline: Long-read and targeted sequencing pipelines for pathogen and mixed-sample genomics
ranked.summary: Long-read and targeted sequencing now recover chromosome-level and high-accuracy sequences directly from natural infections and mixed samples.

ranked.headline: Force links junction adhesion, nuclear deformation and epithelial stratification
ranked.summary: Explicit force-based models now resolve junction, nuclear and multicellular mechanics to link adhesion dynamics with cell state and tissue patterning.

ranked.headline: Simulations link sequence patterning and confinement to condensate organization
ranked.summary: MD simulations resolve HBV pgRNA condensate architecture in capsid confinement, while new sequence-patterning metrics guide IDP phase-behavior design.

ranked.headline: Scaling, criticality and attractor dynamics in large-scale brain network recordings
ranked.summary: Multimodal recordings now test whether criticality, attractor models and decoding link brain dynamics across scales and species.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations resolve membrane remodeling and nuclear pore cargo transport
ranked.summary: Recent simulation studies extend molecular-scale analysis of membrane curvature sorting, nuclear pore cargo transport, and capsid mechanics.
